log.t: ⚔ RALLY: FIGHTERS MOVE TO COVER TESS
📻 Dusk Radio: Good morning. Breakfast is whatever didn't run away. Word is: quarry is full: tap its bubble to collect.
⚔ RALLY: FIGHTERS MOVE TO COVER TESS
⚔ RALLY: FIGHTERS MOVE TO COVER TESS
Finn and Wren are now friends.
Kid 3 and Cole are now friends.
Rio took a Tactical Cap at the Armory.
Rio took a Running Shoes at the Armory.
Kai and Cole are now friends.
Cole and Pip are now friends.
New lead: Old Quarry (High risk, 5 h trip). Open Explore to send a squad. It's gone in about 10 hours.
Wren took a Riot Vest at the Armory.
Wren took a Hunting Rifle at the Armory.
Kid 3 and Kid 3 are now close friends.
Kid 4, Finn, Remy left for Warehouse District.
📻 Dusk Radio: Getting dark. Now's a bad time to remember you left the gate open.
Night falls at 20:00: more zombies, and they come for the town.
A wall section broke! Zombies can walk through until it is repaired (automatic, costs scrap).
💥 A Rotbomb burst and hurt 4 survivors.
Remy and Kid 3 are now close friends.
Night falls: more zombies, and they come for the town.
Dot and Rio are now friends.
Squad back from Warehouse District: ⚙ 77, Lucky Charm · Kid 4 carried home.
Finn got Kid 4 back on their feet. Kid 4 is Wounded until treated at a medical building.
Hugo and Rio are now friends.
Juno, Milo, Juno left for Warehouse District.
